items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: Most Catholics are the Father of Christ, Jesus Christ, and he didn't have no music.

ctx.x: have anything. Well I knew they didn't anymore, I just wondered

if they used to. No they never did. If a fellow desires isn't going with the Catholic, then they can bring them to the Catholic Church, but they don't have that music. They walk, when they get in that block they don't play, they walk to the church and they bring the band, this band, and wait for them until the family goes. They get back in line and they get in the next block they play. But they won't do like that church. There's nothing in the Catholic religion, in the Bible, you see. Most Catholics are the…
Say, you said there was no Excelsior at one time? No Excelsior brass band?
